findings.message: The moov box follows the mdat box, so a player must read to the end of the file before it can play it (not optimized for streaming, no fast start).

The sample entry of track 1 states 2 channels, but the AAC LC stream has 1 (from its configuration, or from its blocks where they carry parametric stereo); the entry's count may be ignored where the codec states its own (ISO/IEC 14496-12 12.2.3).
The AudioSpecificConfig holds 16 bits after its last field.
